_doc: Hand-entered Priest effects (Forever). Healing tags: heal, direct, hot, instant, absorb. Shadow tags: school:shadow, ability:Mind Flay etc.

Power in Light.note: Smite/Penance damage vs Holy Fire targets: a Smite-priest talent; nothing for healers or Shadow.

Twin Disciplines.note: +1%/rank damage and healing of instant casts (Renew, Shield, Prayer of Mending, Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, shadow-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 1.2% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.7% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.7%). Other modes unchanged. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 0.5% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 0.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (0.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Power Word: Shield.note: Beta curve 7/14/20% absorb (Classic 15% at 3/3): healing on the shield source; leveling +1%/rank survivability (every pull opens with a bigger shield). Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 0.8% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 0.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (0.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Martyrdom.note: Focused Casting after being crit: casting through melee while leveling/PvP. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Inner Fire.note: +15%/rank Inner Fire armor and more charges: small survivability. PvP (2026-09-27): low, avoid: The armor already counts as survival; the PvP part is +12 charges (Inner Fire lasts 32 melee or ranged hits instead of 20): fewer mid-fight rebuffs against melee. Discipline builds only (tier 4).

Mental Agility.note: Beta curve 3/7/10% mana on Smite, Holy Fire and instant casts (parser drops the instant part): Renew/Shield/Prayer of Mending/SW:P. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-27, levels 30,60): removing it costs 3.5% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.7% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x1.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (0.7%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, shadow-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 0.5% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.1% on the same scale); mana values moved to the mana limit's unit (x0.40), raid values otherwise unchanged (noise) (0.2%). Other modes unchanged. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 1.1% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 0.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (0.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Inner Focus.note: One free spell with +25% crit every 3 min (parser read it as 100% cost reduction on everything): ~+1% healing, ~+2% mana. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.4% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.8% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.44 to match (0.4%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, shadow-dps, training dummy): removing it costs -1.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.0% on the same scale); mana values moved to the mana limit's unit (x0.40), raid values otherwise unchanged (apl) (1.3%). Other modes unchanged. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 3.1% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 2.0% on the same scale); heal values scaled x1.54 to match (3.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Soul Warding.note: Power Word: Shield -4s cooldown (parsed) and -15% mana. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 1.7% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); heal values scaled x1.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (0.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Penance.note: Channelled 3-hit heal every 12s: beta spellbook ranks 1-4 (levels 30/40/50/60) heal 184/291/482/673 per bolt (100/?/?/355 mana), damage 81 to 131 per bolt: very mana-efficient tank heal -> ~+8% healing throughput and ~+3% mana efficiency. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 5.2% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 5.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (5.7%). Other modes unchanged.

Renewed Hope.note: +2%/rank crit on direct heals to Weakened Soul targets (the shielded tank, ~60% of direct heals) -> +1.2%/rank direct-heal crit. PvP (2026-09-27): high, defensive: Each Flash Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Binding Heal or Penance on a target with Weakened Soul cuts it by 5 s: with Soul Warding the focus target can be reshielded every 5-10 s instead of 15, the core of a Discipline PvP healer. Healer only; unverified (no PvP healer build yet).

Divine Aegis.note: Crit heals shield for 5%/rank of the heal: at ~20% crit that is +1%/rank effective healing.

Power Infusion.note: +20% healing/damage for 15s every 3 min (8.3% uptime) on yourself or a caster: +1.7% self; the raid-DPS use is extra value. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, burst: +20% spell damage and healing for 15 s (3 min cooldown) on yourself or a partner: a burst window. Discipline builds only (tier 7).

Holy Nova.note: Instant AoE heal/damage with no threat: niche. PvP (2026-09-27): low, stealth: Instant 10 yd AoE damage and party heal: pulsing it reveals stealthed rogues and druids before a Sap or Cheap Shot. Healer builds only (Shadowform bars healing spells).

Blessed Recovery.note: Heal 8%/rank of a crit's damage: survivability. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: 1.60.1.70009 adds a trigger on any single hit over 30% of your maximum health: PvP spike hits (crit Pyroblast, Aimed Shot, Ambush) heal back 25% over 6 s. Holy builds only (tier 3).

Inspiration.note: +8%/rank armor on the target for 15s after a crit heal: on a tank that is ~5%/rank less physical damage while up (~70% uptime at raid crit) -> counted as +1.5%/rank effective healing. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 2.7% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 2.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (2.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Binding Heal.note: 1.5s heal on target and self, low threat: replaces Flash Heals when you are taking damage -> ~+3% throughput. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: Heals you and an ally in one 1.5 s cast: self-healing while keeping a trained teammate up. Healer only.

Litany of Light.note: 5%/rank of base cost refunded when alternating healing spells: ~+2%/rank mana.

Spirit of Redemption.note: 15s of free healing after death: small. PvP (2026-09-27): low, burst: 15 s of free healing after you die: team value in battlegrounds only. Holy healer only.

Prayer of Mending.note: Instant bouncing heal (beta rank 1: 172 per jump, up to 6 targets, ranks 2-3 at 50/60) every 10s for 210 mana: the most mana-efficient raid heal -> ~+8% throughput, ~+3% mana. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-30, holy-heal): removing it costs 2.0% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 1.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, heal effects split off unchanged (1.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Holy Precision.note: +6% hit with Holy spells per rank read: heals cannot miss; nothing for Shadow.

Silent Resolve.note: Threat and -5%/rank stun/fear/silence duration: small survivability. 2026-09-27 audit: Holy threat -10%/rank for a raid healer: 0.002/rank heal utility (the loops file's healer reason). PvP (2026-09-27): high, resist: -15% duration of stuns, fears and silences on you at 3/3 (1.60.1.70009): the only CC-duration talent left in Forever priest trees (Unbreakable Will is gone). The -30% Holy threat part is PvE only. Both specs.

Blackout.note: 2%/rank chance per Shadow damage spell to stun 3s: ~5 shadow casts per mob while leveling -> ~10%/rank of mobs stunned once (3s without hits) -> +1%/rank survivability, +0.5%/rank damage (free casts); nothing on bosses. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 2.4% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.50 to match (2.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Spirit Tap.note: 20%/rank chance for +100% Spirit and 50% regen while casting for 15s after a kill: at 5/5 every kill; priests spend ~35% of leveling drinking -> sustain 12/22/30/36/40%. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Shadow Word: Pain.note: +3s/rank duration (18 -> 24s): more damage per cast and fewer recasts -> +5%/rank SW:P damage, +1%/rank mana. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, shadow-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 2.5% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.6% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.6%). Other modes unchanged.

Mind Flay.note: The Shadow filler: a channelled snare-nuke replacing wand time -> ~+15% total damage while leveling, +10% in a raid rotation. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 11.5% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 5.9% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (30.9%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, shadow-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 75.9% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 90.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (90.4%). Other modes unchanged.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 12.7% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x22.01 to match (12.6%). Vampiric Embrace.note: Party healed for 20% of your Shadow damage for 30s, but the beta client gives it a 1 min cooldown (Classic: none) -> 50% uptime: leveling self-healing (-8% downtime, +3% EH); raid party utility. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.5% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.18 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Shadow Weaving.note: 33%/rank chance per Shadow spell to stack +2% Shadow damage (5 stacks, 15s): at 3/3 five stacks are always up (+10%); at 1/3 ~5%. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 3.5% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); re-seeded from its tooltip (an earlier fit had left its values at zero), leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.54 to match (3.5%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, shadow-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 9.4% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 10.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (10.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Silence.note: 5s silence: caster control while leveling. 2026-09-27 audit: the fight lab never gets to use it (0.00 interrupts per kill: casters stand at 30 yd, Silence reaches 20); casters are 9-19% of pulls and one Silence turns 1-2 bolts into melee swings: 0.002. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.2% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 79.5% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 39.6% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x1.87, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (81.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Fade.note: Fade cooldown: leveling survivability. 2026-09-27 audit: a solo priest is the only name on the mob's threat list, so Fade does nothing while leveling; it is the raid threat dump: 0.001/rank in raid and heal. PvP (2026-09-27): zero, escape: Fade (-6 s cooldown) only discourages NPCs (tooltip as in Classic); players ignore it, so the shadow-pvp draft's 2 points are wasted.

Shadow Reach.note: +10%/rank Shadow range: an extra cast before melee while leveling. 2026-09-27 audit: range is the one soft kind raid DPS counts (Mind Flay's 20 yd): 0.002/rank raid utility. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 22.4% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x37.95 to match (23.1%). Twilight Focus.note: 23%/rank chance to ignore pushback: raid healers get hit by raid damage on ~20% of casts -> ~+0.7%/rank throughput; leveling casters ~1%/rank. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 40,60): removing it costs 36.9% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.7% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x49.62 to match (37.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Mana Burn.note: PvP. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, antiheal: Mana Burn 3 -> 2 s cast: a drain of about 750 mana per cast lands between kicks, the priest's tool against healers. Discipline builds only (tier 4).
